text:
Maya: Quick sync — need runtime + infra inputs for the new per-route SLO dashboard. Targets: P50/P95/P99 latency, TTFT (first-token), and tokens/sec by route+model.

Liam: I can own runtime metric names/tags. Do we want ingest to compute percentiles or emit histograms and compute pXX later?

Oscar: Infra wants to avoid exploding cardinality. Prefer summary counters + compact histograms. Precomputed percentiles at ingest are fine only if tags are controlled.

Jun: Dashboard layout needs per-route rows and per-model drilldowns. Proposed tags: route=/api/assistant, model=gptq-13b, region=us-west-2, env=prod, tier=dedicated.

Liam: Add rollout_id and canary=true/false so Console can surface rollout perf.

SRE: +1 on rollout_id. Also emit route.fallback_count when routing policy demotes primary to fallback variant. We need that sparkline.

Maya: Runtime: emit tokens_generated and request_duration_ms. Pipeline can derive tokens_per_sec = tokens_generated / duration_s.

Oscar: Will implement derived tokens_per_sec in pipeline to keep dashboards simple. Proposed metric names:
- redwood.metrics.route.latency_ms.p50/p95/p99
- redwood.metrics.route.ttft_ms.p50/p95/p99
- redwood.metrics.route.tokens_per_sec
- redwood.metrics.route.fallback_count
- redwood.metrics.route.quota_utilization

Liam: Runtime will emit HDR histograms for latency and a counter for TTFT. For prod routes sample_rate=1. Low-volume routes: sample 1:10 with tag metric.sample_rate.

Jun: Sampling needs rescaling before percentile calc. Otherwise dashboards will be inaccurate.

Oscar: Pipeline will rescale counters. For histograms we prefer consistent per-route sampling (sample whole requests). Also store HDR buckets at ingest so pXX can be computed there.

Maya: Console UX: per-model rows showing P50/P95/P99 latency, TTFT, tokens/sec, fallback sparkline, and a top-10 slow routes table. Also a pivot to show model-first view.

SRE: Cardinality risk: route+model+rollout_id+region could explode. Plan: pipeline keeps full granularity but TTLs high-card metrics to 30d and Console lists only top-N by traffic. Set cardinality alerts.

Jun: Also want route.quota_utilization metric to feed autoscaler and show cost impact on the panel.

Maya: Action items: 
- Liam (runtime): emit histogram + ttft counter, include rollout_id tag, publish sample rules doc by Fri EOD.
- Oscar (infra): add rescaling for sampled counters, derive tokens_per_sec, ingest HDR compute job.
- Jun (console): mockup panel layout + top-N logic, will post wireframes.
- SRE: define cardinality alert thresholds and retention policy.

Liam: Note on namespacing: prefix everything with redwood.metrics.* to avoid collisions.

Oscar: I'll open a telemetry schema PR and attach pipeline job ticket.

Maya: I'll create tracking ticket SLO-DASH-498 and assign owners. ConsoleBot: please create the ticket when I confirm.

ConsoleBot: Created ticket SLO-DASH-498 and assigned: Liam, Oscar, Jun, SRE.

Jun: I'll post the initial panel mock at 10:00 tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Maya: Thanks — stay in-thread for followups. If sampling or schema hits blockers flag them here. :sparkles:
